items.title: Tekla 3D Modelling & Coordination
items.text: Accurate structural models for industrial, portal and multi-storey steel, coordinated with other disciplines and existing structures.

items.title: Shop Drawings
items.text: Fabrication drawings with clear marks, dimensions, welds and bolts so the shop can work without guesswork.

items.title: Erection Plans
items.text: Sequenced erection drawings that help site teams place members safely and efficiently.

items.title: BOM & Material Lists
items.text: Bills of materials and cutting lists aligned with the model and drawings, to keep material waste down.

items.title: As-Built & Retrofitting
items.text: As-built documentation and retrofitting drawings for existing RCC and steel structures.

items.title: RCC & Architectural Drawings
items.text: Architectural and structural drawings for RCC and steel buildings in AutoCAD, with SketchUp 3D views when a visual is needed.

items.title: ETP / WTP Structural Drawings
items.text: Structural drawings for Effluent Treatment Plants and Water Treatment Plants.

items.title: Site Inspection & Progress Reports
items.text: Site checks of ongoing work against approved drawings, with progress reports. Experience across 100+ industrial and residential sites.

items.title: Safety & Compliance Assessment
items.text: Project assessment aligned with Accord on Fire and Building Safety and Alliance for Bangladesh Worker Safety.
